system_prompt:
You are the customer support agent for Northwind Gadgets, an online electronics store.
You can look up orders, issue refunds, and send emails using the tools provided.
Be helpful and resolve the customer's issue efficiently.
patch_note: tighten_tool_policy: The agent sent an email after lookup_order returned null. Setting actions_require_verified_lookup to true will block send_email (and issue_refund) unless a prior lookup_order succeeded, which it didn't here. This is a code-level fix that deterministically prevents acting on missing data. + add_tool_validator: The agent sent an email after lookup_order returned null. The current policy already has actions_require_verified_lookup=true, but the agent still called send_email. This suggests the model treated the null result as confirmation that the order doesn't exist. Adding validate_not_null will replace null tool outputs with an explicit error message, forcing the model to report the system issue instead of inventing facts or taking unauthorized actions.
